html:
Greetings, Agents.


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

In this patch, you will meet the successor of the Nova Corps 
and a warrior of the Guardians of the Galaxy, 
arriving from a special dimension known as the MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.


New Tier-4 Advancements and Uniforms have been added for 
Nova (Richard Rider), who wields incredible abilities through the Nova Force, 
and Phyla-Vell, a master swordswoman and possessor of Cosmic Energy.

 

Agents, please download the 2/10 (Tue) patch 
to check out their new skills and enhanced power!

 

■ 2/10 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 2/11 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 2/10 (Tue) 19:00 (PST)

 

[2/11 (Wed) 2:42 (UTC+0), 2/10 (Tue) 18:42 (PST) added]
The patch has been completed as of 2/11 (Wed) 2:41 (UTC+0), 2/10 (Tue) 18:41 (PST).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ Two New Uniforms

 

Two new Uniforms, Nova (Richard Rider) <Marvel Cosmic Invasion>, 
and Phyla-Vell <Marvel Cosmic Invasion> have been added.
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <Cosmic Invasion Update Celebration 1st Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

▣ Nova (Richard Rider) & Phyla-Vell Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancements are now available for Nova (Richard Rider) and Phyla-Vell, 
who fight for the survival, order, and peace of the universe rather than their own honor.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes


1. The Leader Skill names for Ultron <Modern>, Ultron Prime <Avengers: Age of Ultron>, Ultron Mark 1 <Avengers: Age of Ultron>, and Ultron Mark 3 <Avengers: Age of Ultron> have been updated in certain languages.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes


1. Craft: An issue where the acquisition quantity for "Rank Up Materials" was displayed as 1 on the main crafting screen, even though the actual amount acquired per craft is 5 has been fixed.


2. An issue where the attacking/attacked conditions for Marvel Boy were not being displayed when selected as a World Boss Ally has been fixed.


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
